RULES.RULE: Clinically meaningful framework/intervention selection remains with the therapist/qualified professional. SESSION EVIDENCE → PLENRA STRUCTURES EVIDENCE → BOUNDED OPTIONS / RECOMMENDATION → PROFESSIONAL SELECTS OR AUTHORIZES → PLENRA PERSONALIZES → ACTION / ARTIFACT → FEEDBACK → NEXT RECOMMENDATION. Plenra may analyze, structure, personalize and recommend within defined boundaries, never independently replace professional treatment selection. Minimize friction; allow preference profiles and pre-authorized boundaries where appropriate.
RULES.SUPERSESSION_RELATIONSHIP: Prospectively settles FD-R1 authority principle; does not adjudicate CON-008 or reconstruct missing maps.
RULES.NOTES: Policy decided; scope-specific mechanisms, exclusions and progress validation remain D-CLINICAL.

RULES.RULE: Raw session text is not the permanent default record. RAW SESSION INPUT → PII MINIMIZATION / MASKING → STRUCTURED EXTRACTION → ARTIFACT / RECOMMENDATION → STRUCTURED CONTINUITY STATE → DURABLE THERAPIST SUMMARY / EXPORT → RAW INPUT EXPIRES ACCORDING TO RETENTION POLICY. Clearly inform therapist/coach that Plenra is not to be assumed a permanent searchable archive of original raw text. Preserve a durable useful summary/export. Exact retention periods are implementation/legal parameters. Optional paid extended encrypted archive/search is HYPOTHESIS_TO_VALIDATE; never default to indefinite raw-text retention.
RULES.SUPERSESSION_RELATIONSHIP: Prospective data model; historical free-text/no-free-text CON-003 remains unresolved.
RULES.NOTES: No fixed retention period or legal compliance claim.

RULES.RULE: Initial clinically meaningful intervention requires professional authorization. An approved envelope may define framework/mechanism, goal, permitted difficulty range, duration and allowed adaptation dimensions. Bounded wording, micro-actions, difficulty within range, reminders and reflection prompts may adapt automatically within the approved envelope. Material changes outside it require renewed professional approval. Preserve approved_by, approved_scope, artifact/intervention_version and timestamp. Minimize approval friction.
RULES.SUPERSESSION_RELATIONSHIP: Prospective envelope model; CON-002 and historical per-printable approval wording stay preserved.
RULES.NOTES: Does not grant blanket release authority, bypass email consent or infer a historical coaching exemption.

RULES.RULE: Deliver meaningful value before requesting identity/contact unless functionally required for the requested action. USEFUL RESULT → optional registration/contact → continuity / saved history / client printable / progress tracking is permitted. WITHHOLD CORE PROMISED RESULT → require contact → reveal result is prohibited. Paid/registered continuation is allowed. Never optimize emotional dependency, artificial pressure or coercive continuation.
RULES.SUPERSESSION_RELATIONSHIP: Prospectively settles value-first policy; no claim that original memo adoption or CON-007 was recovered.
RULES.NOTES: Applies across candidate surfaces; exact acceptance tests require validation.

RULES.RULE: Professional clinical authorization, Central Agent blueprint/production approval and recipient delivery consent are distinct. Provider routing cannot bypass FD-R1/FD-R3; unapproved scope or uncertain envelope membership must return to professional review.

RULES.RULE: AMOS_DOES_NOT_SELECT_AGENTS_BY_DEFAULT. NEED → CAPABILITY → PROVIDER → ACTION → VERIFICATION. Autonomously discover/select capabilities by task fit, evidence, reliability, cost, speed, authority, risk and verification requirements. DISCOVERABLE ≠ AUTOMATICALLY_ACTIVATED; AGENT_IP ≠ AGENT_INSTANCE; CAPABILITY ≠ PROVIDER. Do not instantiate all agents for every project. Providers may include Codex, Computer Use, Grok Bot, Plugins, APIs, Make and future replaceable providers. Escalate to Amos only when selection materially changes authority, risk, meaningful cost or irreversible/high-impact action.
RULES.NOTES: Direct owner governance requirement represented as a derived architecture rule; no provider activated.

RULES.RULE: Preserve PayPal in the existing revenue architecture; do not casually substitute another payment provider. Any material provider change requires explicit scoped evaluation and the authority/risk/cost escalation rule.

RULES.RULE: Keep VERIFIED_COMMERCIAL_OUTCOME, VERIFIED_OPERATIONAL_OUTCOME, VERIFIED_PRODUCT_USER_OUTCOME, VERIFIED_DECISION_LEARNING_OUTCOME and HISTORICAL_PUBLIC_OUTCOME separate. Never merge counters. OUTCOME_EXISTS ≠ BELANAR_CAUSED_OUTCOME. Every record requires all twelve outcome fields; independent evidence of existence does not establish causal attribution.

RULES.RULE: NO MATERIAL DECISION SHOULD REMAIN AMBIGUOUS BY DEFAULT. Transition every material unknown to DECIDED, FUTURE_PRODUCT_DECISION or DEFERRED_WITH_TRIGGER. Deferred entries require DECISION, WHY_DEFERRED, EVIDENCE_NEEDED, ACTIVATION_TRIGGER and OWNER. Continuously compress overlapping unknowns into root decisions; review at each relevant planning gate, merge duplicates and close resolved roots rather than indefinitely accumulate lists.
RULES.NOTES: decision_debt.json is the candidate root register; historical missing-source inventories remain provenance.
